result:
Only the new test file was added; nothing else was modified.

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/DurationFormatUtilsAgentTest.java` with 28 self-contained JUnit 5 tests covering `DurationFormatUtils`'s full public API:

- `formatDuration` — basic patterns, zero-padding on/off, zero duration, negative-input error, the optional-block table examples from the class Javadoc, escaped-quote literals, and all four `lexx` parse errors (nested optional, unopened `]`, unmatched `[`, unmatched `'`)
- `formatDurationHMS`, `formatDurationISO`, and the `ISO_EXTENDED_FORMAT_PATTERN` constant
- `formatDurationWords` — pluralization, and leading/trailing zero suppression individually and combined
- `formatPeriod`/`formatPeriodISO` — basic ranges, the default-timezone overload, the leap-February month-borrowing example straight from the class Javadoc (Jan 15 → Mar 10 = 1 month 26 days), month-to-day and year-to-month folding when a field is omitted from the pattern, zero-length periods, and the `startMillis > endMillis` error
- the deprecated public no-arg constructor

Verified with `mvn test -Dtest=DurationFormatUtilsAgentTest`: 28/28 pass, no other files touched.
